Test the wells and ensure correct data collection through a report to be presented to the Well Testing Department. Participate on plant troubleshooting. Inform Production Supervisor when the system is unstable or malfunctioning. Other duties that are correlated to the function as directed and requested by Production Supervisor Or Production Superintendent. Keep up certification applied to the function and medical certificates up to date. Attend Company training as defined. Perform all emergency duties assigned to their function, in response to the emergency, if applicable. Ensure compliance with BW procedures, applied to the function, including BW Permit to Work System. Need to be fully familiar and comply with Company Policies, Quality, HSE and all Procedures assigned to his title/position. Anticipate and notice any unsafe condition and assure that the correction actions are taken according to procedure. Responsible for your own safety and for the safety of your co-workers. Education Technical education required; Engineering degree is a plus Advanced English Level Experience Experience as a Control Room Operator or in a similar role. Knowledge Knowledge of Fire & Gas (F&G) detection logic and Emergency Shutdown (ESD) system architecture, including shutdown levels and Cause & Effect matrix, sufficient to recognize abnormal conditions and respondperthecompany's instructions. Knowledge of process safety systems and safe operating envelopes of the topside process, sufficient to support troubleshooting and inform the Production Supervisor of instability or malfunction. Knowledge of shift handover and logbook recording requirements for fire and gas systems, process conditions, and inhibition status. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Buscamos pessoas que gostem de investigar problemas, propor soluções, colocar ideias em prática e acompanhar o impacto gerado por suas entregas. Diversidade: Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Procuramos uma profissional com maturidade, excelente apresentação pessoal, comunicação refinada e postura compatível com um ambiente premium, que compreenda que cada contato com a paciente representa uma extensão da imagem e do posicionamento da clínica. PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES Recepcionar pacientes com cordialidade, discrição e excelência no atendimento; Realizar atendimento presencial, telefônico e via WhatsApp; Realizar agendamentos, confirmações, remarcações e cancelamentos de consultas e procedimentos; Organizar e acompanhar a agenda dos profissionais, garantindo fluidez no atendimento; Realizar o check-in e check-out das pacientes; Orientar pacientes sobre horários, procedimentos, preparos e demais informações pertinentes ao atendimento; Realizar cadastro e atualização dos dados das pacientes no sistema; Fazer acompanhamento de pacientes e retornos, quando necessário; Realizar contato ativo para confirmação de consultas e procedimentos; Apoiar a organização da jornada da paciente, identificando necessidades e antecipando possíveis demandas; Realizar cobranças, recebimentos e fechamento de atendimentos, quando aplicável; Apoiar processos comerciais da clínica, contribuindo para conversão e fidelização; Manter a recepção organizada, impecável e alinhada aos padrões de apresentação da clínica; Zelar pela confidencialidade das informações das pacientes; Atuar de forma integrada com a equipe, contribuindo para o bom funcionamento da operação; Cumprir protocolos, processos e padrões de atendimento estabelecidos pela clínica. PERFIL DESEJADO Experiência comprovada com atendimento ao público de alto padrão, especialmente em hotéis, clínicas de alto padrão, joalherias, varejo de luxo ou empresas com forte foco em experiência do cliente; Experiência anterior em clínica dermatológica, estética ou área da saúde será um diferencial importante; Excelente apresentação pessoal e postura profissional; Comunicação verbal e escrita clara, cordial e elegante; Maturidade profissional e inteligência emocional para lidar com diferentes perfis de pacientes; Perfil organizado, proativo e resolutivo; Discrição e ética no tratamento de informações; Atenção aos detalhes e senso de urgência; Facilidade para trabalhar com agenda, sistemas e ferramentas digitais; Capacidade de trabalhar com alto volume de informações sem perder a qualidade do atendimento; Perfil acolhedor, mas ao mesmo tempo firme e profissional; Senso de responsabilidade e comprometimento com horários e processos; Facilidade para trabalhar em equipe; Interesse genuíno em oferecer uma experiência diferenciada às pacientes. REQUISITOS Ensino médio completo; Experiência comprovada em atendimento ao público; Conhecimento básico de informática e facilidade com sistemas; Boa comunicação escrita para atendimento via WhatsApp; Disponibilidade para eventuais extensões de horário, conforme necessidade da clínica. Cursos complementares em atendimento ao cliente, hotelaria, vendas, secretariado, administração, saúde, estética ou áreas relacionadas serão valorizados. LOCALIZAÇÃO Ipanema – Rio de Janeiro/RJ INFORMAÇÕES DA VAGA Salário: R$ 2.200,00 Bonificações: conforme desempenho e cumprimento de metas Vale-refeição: R$ 22,00 por dia Vale-transporte: conforme necessidade Contratação: CLT Horário: segunda a sexta-feira, das 10h às 19h #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Técnico em Mecânica
description: Técnico em Mecânica - - - - - - - - - - - - A Michelin, empresa líder de pneus, se dedica a melhorar de forma sustentável a mobilidade de pessoas e bens, fabricando e comercializando pneus e serviços para cada tipo de veículo, incluindo aviões, automóveis, bicicletas, motocicletas, escavadeiras, equipamentos agrícolas e caminhões. Com sede em Clermont-Ferrand, França, a Michelin está presente em mais de 170 países, tem 111.200 empregados e opera 67 fábricas de produção em 17 países diferentes. A chegada da Michelin no Brasil foi na data de 1927, com o início das operações de seu escritório comercial em São Paulo. Em 1981, foi inaugurada a primeira fábrica da Michelin em território nacional, na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, para a produção de pneus para caminhões e ônibus. Hoje estamos presentes em 3 Unidades Industriais - Campo Grande (RJ), Itatiaia (RJ), Manaus (AM) e nossa sede corporativa que está localizada no Rio de Janeiro - RJ. Outra importante atuação da empresa no país é a Reserva Ecológica Michelin, no sul da Bahia, onde está instalado o programa Michelin Ouro Verde Bahia. Faça parte de uma equipe na qual você será incentivado a desenvolver todo o seu potencial e alcançar seus objetivos. Tratamos nossos funcionários e clientes com a mesma atenção e inovamos cada vez mais a favor do desenvolvimento sustentável. Preferir a Michelin, é crescer. Valorizamos as singularidades de cada um e consideramos a diversidade como um valor, por isso reforçamos este convite para você, que se autodeclara negro ou negra, do gênero feminino ou masculino, LGBTQIA+, pessoa com deficiência ou acima de 50 anos. PRINCIPAIS REALIZAÇÕES ESPERADAS Aplicação dos métodos ou das práticas (operações transcorridas dentro das normas de segurança, qualidade e respeito às orientações) Manutenção da conformidade equipamentos (padrões, limpeza, tempo de ciclo, parâmetros influentes etc.) Intervenções são codificadas, documentadas e analisadas Eficácia de todas as intervenções prevenção de panes, regularização da falha em tempo otimizado,… Eficiência de todas as intervenções (recursos usados, consumo de PDR, eficiência energética da instalação mantida). PRÉ REQUISITOS Curso técnico em mecânica, eletromecânica ou mecatrônica Desejável experiência em manutenção industrial Ensino Médio Completo BENEFÍCIOS Vale-alimentação Assistência médica Assistência odontológica Auxílio fretado Bicicletário Cesta de natal Convênio com empresas parceiras Desconto em produtos Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados Plano de Aquisição de Ações Previdência privada Programa de treinamentos Refeitório Seguro de vida Vale-transporte Plataforma Oriente Me Clube SESI Informamos que não contratamos empresas terceiras que cobrem dos candidatos para a participação em nossos processos. Caso tenha dúvidas, procure nossos canais oficiais ou nossos recrutadores. Avancer ensemble, un engagement réciproque et responsable : Rejoindre Michelin c’est vous développer dans une entreprise où respect, dialogue, passion et confiance sont la clé de nos relations avec nos employés. En construisant avec nous votre parcours professionnel, vous évoluez et c’est tout Michelin qui avance. Avec plus de 114 000 personnes dans le monde, de 170 nationalités, la diversité des talents est un moteur fondamental de créativité et d’innovation. Responsabilisation, autonomie et esprit d’équipe créent l’engagement collectif au service de tous nos clients. C’est donc ensemble que nous innovons et faisons progresser la mobilité durablement partout dans le monde, sous toutes ses formes, avec passion, enthousiasme et fierté. Osez Michelin et trouvez votre meilleure façon d’avancer! #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: ENFERMEIRO(A) - HOME CARE
description: Job description A Leve Saúde é uma operadora de saúde carioca que nasceu com o propósito de transformar a forma como o cuidado em saúde é oferecido no Brasil. Acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além de oferecer planos — é construir relações, escutar de verdade e estar presente na jornada de cada pessoa. Desde o início, apostamos em um modelo mais próximo, acolhedor e resolutivo. Com equipes próprias e rede integrada, promovemos uma experiência de saúde mais leve, eficiente e centrada no paciente. O que nos move: Tornar o cuidado em saúde mais humano e acessível; Reduzir burocracias e facilitar o acesso a serviços de qualidade; Usar a tecnologia como aliada para melhorar a experiência e os resultados em saúde. Como fazemos isso: Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência; Com uma equipe multidisciplinar que acompanha de perto a jornada dos beneficiários; Com um time interno comprometido com inovação, qualidade e propósito. Estamos à procura de um(a) Enfermeiro comprometido(a) em oferecer suporte de qualidade aos beneficiários, acompanhando de perto as demandas de saúde e promovendo um atendimento humanizado e eficiente. Main responsibilities Avaliar criteriosamente relatórios médicos e perfis assistenciais para a captação e admissão de pacientes, unindo a visão de saúde humanizada à viabilidade técnica e financeira; Elaborar, revisar e dimensionar o Plano de Atenção Domiciliar (PAD), ajustando com precisão a carga horária de enfermagem, insumos, medicamentos e equipamentos ao real nível de complexidade do paciente; Gerenciar com eficiência os recursos assistenciais: controlar cotas de materiais, dietas enterais/parenterais e equipamentos (oxigenoterapia, bombas de infusão, etc.), evitando desperdícios e garantindo o suprimento contínuo sem comprometer a qualidade do cuidado; Aplicar e monitorar escalas de elegibilidade e complexidade (ex.: ABEMID, NEAD) para reavaliar periodicamente o plano terapêutico e promover a desospitalização segura e progressiva (desmame/alta domiciliar); Acompanhar a evolução clínica dos pacientes com um olhar atento à prevenção de riscos (lesões por pressão, infecções, quedas) e identificação precoce de descompensações; Realizar a gestão e auditoria de prontuários de campo, alinhando a prática da equipe de ponta aos padrões de qualidade e ao uso racional dos recursos contratados; Dar suporte técnico e orientação à equipe e aos familiares/cuidadores, promovendo o engajamento e o cuidado focado na autonomia do paciente. Requirements and skills Graduação completa em Enfermagem com registro ativo no COREN; Pós-graduação ou especialização (concluída ou em andamento) em Atenção Domiciliar, Gestão em Saúde, Cuidados Paliativos, Saúde do Idoso ou Saúde da Família/Coletiva; Experiência anterior em Home Care, com conhecimento prático no equilíbrio entre a gestão assistencial e o controle de custos/recursos; Domínio na aplicação de escalas de complexidade assistencial (ABEMID, NEAD); Visão crítica para auditoria concorrente de prontuários e otimização de processos assistenciais; Pacote Office intermediário; Forte perfil comunicativo, empatia para entender a jornada do paciente/família e raciocínio analítico para solução de problemas operacionais. Additional information Vale Refeição: R$ 44,00 por dia (desconto simbólico de R$ 1,00 ao mês); Vale Transporte; Day Off no dia do aniversário; Plano de Saúde – sem desconto em folha; Plano Odontológico – sem desconto em folha; Total Pass – incentivo ao bem-estar e à atividade física; Descontos em instituições de ensino; Programa Leve Mente – voltado à saúde emocional; Parceria com Sesc - garante aos nossos colaboradores acesso exclusivo a uma rede completa de lazer, cultura, esportes e turismo, promovendo mais bem-estar e qualidade de vida; Horário de trabalho: segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Junior Data Management Analyst
description: Salary Range: R$48,000.00 To R$54,000.00 Annually Full Time Position, Monday - Friday The Company Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers.KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers.Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities. Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities Launch your career in data management with Katalyst. As a Junior Data Management Analyst, you will play an important role in supporting the intake, transfer, loading, quality control, cleanup, and delivery of geophysical and subsurface data for client projects. Working alongside experienced professionals, you will gain hands-on experience with seismic, non-seismic, and well data while developing a strong understanding of data governance standards, industry best practices, and Katalyst's proprietary tools and processes. This position offers an excellent opportunity for individuals who are detail-oriented, eager to learn, and interested in building technical expertise within the energy data management industry. The successful candidate will support both client site operations and internal project workflows, follow established procedures, communicate effectively with team members and clients, and contribute to the successful execution of data management projects while developing their professional and technical skills. Key Responsibilities: Support data management activities, including receipt, transfer, loading, validation, quality assurance, cleanup, organization, availability, and governance of files and data in accordance with established procedures. Monitor and organize data intake and output workflows through the Geophysical Data Network (RDG), client systems, and approved Katalyst tools. Perform operational procedures, complete checklists, conduct basic quality checks, and execute approved commands and scripts under appropriate guidance. Maintain accurate time tracking using corporate tools and support timely handling of billing-related information. Update control systems, spreadsheets, activity records, indicators, and operational documentation, including process notes, decision records, issue tracking, and status updates. Identify, record, and engage errors, inconsistencies, routine data issues, and technical concerns to the responsible analysts or project team members. Support data preparation, basic reporting, storage monitoring, disk usage review, workflow progress tracking, and data quality reporting as requested. Follow information security, confidentiality, and data governance standards when handling client, project, and company data. Communicate clearly and professionally with client personnel, Katalyst operational staff, and project team members to support effective project delivery. Qualifications & Skills: Working knowledge of data transfer concepts, file organization, and data loading processes, with a willingness to learn Katalyst and client-specific systems. Basic understanding of subsurface data types, including seismic, non-seismic, well data, related documents, and associated file formats. Strong attention to detail and ability to follow documented procedures accurately. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with basic proficiency in English. Ability to identify routine problems, document findings, cross-reference information, and escalation issues appropriately. Collaborative mindset with a strong team orientation and willingness to support shared project goals. Knowledge of key Microsoft Office tools, including PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and Outlook. Basic knowledge of Linux commands used to browse, query, and copy files. Basic knowledge of Python or another programming language. Basic knowledge of file integrity checking and related quality control concepts. Strategic thinking and analytical capacity to review, compare, and connect information from multiple sources. Ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain professionalism in a client-focused environment. Position Type and Expected Hours of Work: This is a full-time position. As a full-time position, the Junior Data Management Analyst is eligible to participate in benefits coverage offered to Katalyst employees based on geographical location. This position may be performed remotely, at a Katalyst office, or on a client site. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with occasional evening or weekend work required to support project or client needs. Required Education and Experience Undergraduate degree in data management, geoscience, information technology, databases, or a related field preferred. Minimum of two years of relevant experience in data management, geophysical or subsurface data support, data loading, data transfer, technical operations, or a related analytical environment. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Integrity Engineer
description: Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliver powerful solutions. Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSO units and associated equipment. As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring that all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector. Key Responsibilities Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up-to-date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records. Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively. Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations. Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details. Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modifications schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements. Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety-critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation. Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance. Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements. Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance. Key Competencies Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management. Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity. Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality. Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment. Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions. Analytical and Problem-solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions. Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence. Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands-on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly. Qualifications And Experience Engineering degree is mandatory. CREA-RJ accreditation is required. Post-Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage. Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred. Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable. Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders. Why Join Us? At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward-thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment. If you are a focused, detail-oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team-oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Operations Geologist / Petrophysicist
description: The Operations Geologist/Petrophysicist supports safe, efficient and environmentally responsible Geological operations, serving as the main liaison between the Subsurface and Drilling departments and as the focal point of communication with offshore Geological service providers. The role oversees the entire well construction process, from planning through post-mortem analysis, supporting key operational decisions (such as casing shoe depth selection and geosteering), preparing technical documentation, and ensuring compliance with established procedures and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Support safe, efficient and environmentally responsible Geological operations. Main liaison between the Subsurface and the Drilling departments. Focal point of communication between office and offshore Geological service providers (Wellsite Geologists, MWD/LWD, ML, WL), supporting decision-making as needed (e.g. casing shoe depth selection, geosteering). Support the complete well construction process, encompassing well planning, execution and post-mortem analyses, ensuring that the established procedures are met and well objectives are achieved in a cost-effective manner. Prepare documentation related to the well construction process (e.g. Drilling Program, Daily Reports, End-of-Well, Composite Logs). Plan formation evaluation data acquisition in exploration and development wells in coordination with the Drilling department and service providers. Manage temperature, pore pressure and Geomechanical data pre-spud, while drilling and post-mortem. Follow-up geological operations, attending regular and on-demand operational meetings. Quality assurance and quality control of wireline and logging while drilling logs. Formation evaluation and generation of composite logs, integrating log, core and dynamic data to provide inputs to static and dynamic models. Manage raw and interpreted formation evaluation logs, including maintaining databases. Support designing laboratory analysis . Ensure compliance with local regulations, including delivery of required documentation to regulator. Education Bachelor's degree in Geoscience. Master's degree is a plus. Experience & Qualifications Legally available to work in Brazil. Ability to write and communicate fluently in English and Portuguese . Strong background in oil and gas operations Proficiency in industry standard petrophysical software. Working knowledge of well operations. Flexibility/availability for occasional offshore work. Ability to work in a collaborative, multi-disciplinary environment. Offshore experience desired, experience in the Southeast Brazil basins a plus. Knowledge in Geomechanics a plus. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Software Engineer, Agent Platform
description: At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs. Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We’ve also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.” Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here. The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation. About the Role Commure is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own the platform powering our fleet of OpenClaw agents. Across Commure, we use autonomous agents to support teams, execute operational workflows, interact with internal systems, and turn organizational knowledge into action. As the number and capabilities of these agents grow, we need a strong technical foundation for deploying, operating, observing, and improving them safely at scale. You’ll own that foundation. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering and applied AI. You’ll build the infrastructure that runs our agents, develop the harnesses that govern how they reason and act, and establish the tools engineers need to create and deploy new agents quickly. You’ll also operate the existing agent fleet and ensure it remains secure, reliable, observable, and cost‑efficient. We’re looking for a strong Python engineer with deep Linux fundamentals who can own both the agent software and the environments where it runs. The ideal candidate combines platform‑engineering rigor with practical experience building LLM‑powered agents and is comfortable moving between Python application code, Bash‑based operational work, Linux virtual machines, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands‑on role for someone equally comfortable working inside a Linux VM, debugging a Kubernetes workload, writing Python services and automation, designing an agent tool interface, investigating an LLM failure, and improving a deployment pipeline. What You’ll Do Own the infrastructure and runtime environment for Commure’s fleet of OpenClaw agents. Build, configure, deploy, and troubleshoot agents running across Linux‑based virtual machines. Develop Python services, automation, operational tooling, and agent integrations. Design, build, and operate agent harnesses that support tool use, memory, context management, permissions, scheduling, retries, and human escalation. Create a standardized platform for engineers to develop, test, deploy, and update agents safely. Deploy and operate agent workloads across Linux virtual machines, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud or AWS. Use Bash and standard Linux tooling to investigate system behavior, automate environment management, and resolve production issues. Build reliable systems for agent scheduling, background execution, queues, concurrency management, and long‑running tasks. Develop integrations that allow agents to interact with internal services, databases, APIs, communication platforms, and operational tools. Establish secure approaches to secrets, credentials, identity, permissions, and access control for autonomous agents. Build evaluation frameworks that measure agent reliability, task completion, tool accuracy, latency, and cost. Implement production observability across agent traces, prompts, tool calls, infrastructure, failures, and resource consumption. Create dashboards, alerting, and incident‑response processes for agent and platform health. Diagnose failures across application code, model behavior, third‑party tools, networks, containers, virtual machines, and cloud infrastructure. Improve the efficiency and resilience of the platform as agent usage and workload complexity grow. Work closely with product engineers and internal teams to convert promising agent prototypes into dependable production systems. Establish best practices for developing and operating autonomous agents across Commure. What You Have Professional experience building and operating production software, infrastructure, or internal platforms. Strong proficiency in Python, which will be the primary language for agent development, platform tooling, integrations, and automation. Excellent familiarity with Linux environments and hands‑on experience developing, deploying, and debugging software on virtual machines. Strong Bash and command‑line skills, including shell scripting, process management, networking diagnostics, filesystem operations, package management, and log investigation. Experience managing software across fleets of virtual machines, including configuration, deployment, monitoring, access management, and failure recovery. Strong hands‑on experience building and operating production systems on Google Cloud Platform or Amazon Web Services, including compute, networking, storage, identity and access management, and observability. Experience deploying and managing Linux virtual machines and containerized workloads in cloud environments. Hands‑on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and containerized production workloads. Experience building infrastructure, deployment systems, internal developer platforms, or distributed application runtimes. Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, configuration management, secrets management, and automated deployments. Hands‑on experience building with large language models, autonomous agents, or agent harnesses. An understanding of agent concepts such as tool calling, memory, context management, planning, retries, evaluations, permissions, and human‑in‑the‑loop execution. Experience monitoring and debugging distributed systems using logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerts. A strong understanding of production reliability, including failure recovery, idempotency, rate limiting, concurrency management, and incident response. The ability to balance fast experimentation with the security and reliability required for production systems. Strong ownership and communication skills, including comfort working across product, infrastructure, security, and operational teams. A builder mindset and excitement about creating infrastructure for a rapidly evolving category of software. Nice to Have You have built, extended, deployed, or operated an OpenClaw agent. You have contributed to OpenClaw or another open‑source agent framework. Experience operating a fleet of autonomous or long‑running AI agents. Experience building multi‑tenant agent platforms or internal developer platforms. Experience with agent evaluation, tracing, replay, simulation, or regression testing. Experience with browser agents, computer‑use agents, or agents that interact with external systems. Familiarity with model gateways, inference providers, prompt versioning, token accounting, and LLM cost optimization. Experience securing workloads that access sensitive data or high‑impact production tools. Familiarity with Swift and experience contributing to or supporting native Apple client applications. Experience in healthcare, revenue cycle management, or another regulated industry. What Success Looks Like Within your first several months, you will: Develop a deep understanding of our existing OpenClaw agents, infrastructure, and operational workflows. Make the agent fleet easier to deploy, observe, debug, and maintain. Establish clear reliability and performance metrics for agents running in production. Reduce the time required to take an agent from prototype to production. Improve safeguards around credentials, permissions, tool execution, and sensitive data. Improve the reliability, repeatability, and security of our Linux VM and Kubernetes‑based agent environments. Create a platform that allows Commure teams to build increasingly capable agents without reinventing the underlying infrastructure. Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in @commure.com. Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Lead Auditor
description: Lead credibility where it matters most. Shape how the global mining and metals sector demonstrates responsible, ethical, and socially sound performance. Why This Role Matters As global scrutiny on mining and metals intensifies—from investors, communities, regulators, and Indigenous Peoples—credible, independent assurance has never been more critical. In this executive‑level technical role, you will sit at the intersection of social performance, human rights, and operational accountability , ensuring mining organizations meet internationally recognized standards while building trust with affected stakeholders. Your expertise will directly support responsible resource development and meaningful social outcomes across global supply chains. What Your Impact Is Serve as a trusted authority delivering high‑quality certification and assurance audits against leading sustainability, social, and management system standards. Strengthen client credibility on human rights, labour practices, Indigenous engagement, and grievance mechanisms. Influence better industry outcomes by shaping audit findings into clear, actionable insights for senior decision‑makers. Help evolve ERM CVS’s assurance methodologies, raising the bar across the mining and metals sector worldwide. Demonstrated experience in social impact assessment (SIA), FPIC, Indigenous Peoples’ rights, resettlement, or social performance within mining or related sectors. Proven audit experience, including: A minimum of 10 audits, or 3+ years where auditing represents at least 25% of professional responsibilities within the last 5 years. Practical exposure to on‑site mining or minerals operations. Willingness to travel internationally up to 50%. Preferred Lead Auditor qualification for ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 9001, and/or ISO 50001. Familiarity with ISO/IEC 17021 accreditation requirements. Multilingual capability, particularly English, Spanish, and Portuguese (additional languages such as French or Bahasa are an asset). Experience mentoring auditors or supporting technical capability development within certification or assurance teams. Key Responsibilities Deliver third‑party certification and assurance audits across international standards, including ISO frameworks, IRMA, The Copper Mark, ICMM, ASI, and related social and ESG criteria. Evaluate client conformance, performance, and maturity across management systems and social performance requirements. Lead audit planning, execution, and reporting within multi‑disciplinary teams, ensuring methodological rigor and consistency. Prepare clear, high‑quality audit reports that articulate findings, non‑conformities, risks, and opportunities for improvement. Engage directly with client leadership, workforce representatives, communities, and Indigenous stakeholders in line with audit protocols. Manage certification projects end‑to‑end, balancing scope, schedule, quality, and budget. Act as the primary client interface throughout the project lifecycle, building trusted advisory relationships. title: Diretor(a) do Hub de Engajamento Estratégico
description: Descrição: 1. COMO É SER UMA PESSOA DIRETORA DO HUB DE ENGAJAMENTO ESTRATÉGICO EM MSF-BRASIL? Você irá liderar a equipe multidisciplinar do Hub de Engajamento Estratégico de MSF-Brasil, integrando comunicação, gestão de marca, mobilização de recursos e parcerias estratégicas em uma estratégia consistente de engajamento com a sociedade brasileira, suportados por sistemas tecnológicos adequados e análise transversal de dados. Você também será responsável por garantir que as ações do Hub ampliem o conhecimento, a confiança e o engajamento do público brasileiro com a missão médico-humanitária de Médicos Sem Fronteiras e traduzam, de forma impactante e acessível, as realidades vividas pelas populações atendidas, fortalecendo a reputação institucional da organização e promovendo o crescimento sustentável da base de doadores e da receita proveniente de contribuições de indivíduos, empresas e outros parceiros. Além disso, você irá atuar como liderança estratégica responsável por desenvolver uma visão integrada para o Hub, promovendo o alinhamento contínuo entre as equipes multidisciplinares, tomada de decisão baseada em evidências, inovação contínua e foco em impactos mensuráveis, sempre em consonância com os princípios e valores da organização. 2. QUAIS SERÃO SEUS DESAFIOS? Liderar a transformação organizacional do Hub de Engajamento Estratégico e consolidá-lo como um ecossistema integrado de comunicação, marca, mobilização de recursos, dados, tecnologia e parcerias, conduzindo uma jornada gradual de amadurecimento organizacional, fortalecimento de lideranças e ampliação progressiva da autonomia das equipes, bem como fomentando colaboração entre áreas, fortalecendo a cultura de tomada de decisão baseada em dados e impulsionando a adoção de métodos ágeis pelos times do Hub em um ambiente dinâmico e multidisciplinar; Liderar a visão e a estratégia de posicionamento, engajamento e atração de recursos de MSF-Brasil, zelando pela reputação da Organização e garantindo alinhamento entre as diferentes células do Hub e com outras áreas de MSF-Brasil; Ampliar a base de apoiadores da organização, testando novas abordagens e engajando novas audiências por meio de estratégias inovadoras e ousadas, contribuindo para a sustentabilidade da operação de captação de recursos, e ampliando a contribuição de MSF-Brasil para o projetos médico-humanitários da organização. 3. COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO? Consolidação e Evolução do Hub Liderar o processo de consolidação do Hub por meio de uma abordagem faseada, equilibrando atuação direta em temas estratégicos e operacionais quando necessário com a construção gradual e progressiva da autonomia e da capacidade decisória das lideranças das células e suas equipes; Desenvolver e implementar a visão estratégica do Hub, alinhada ao Planejamento Estratégico de MSF-Brasil, monitorando resultados e ajustando prioridades com base em dados e aprendizados; Garantir a integração entre as diferentes células do Hub, promovendo alinhamento estratégico, colaboração e objetivos compartilhados; Liderar a evolução da estrutura, dos processos e dos modelos de trabalho do Hub, fortalecendo a inovação, a transformação organizacional, a cultura orientada por dados e as metodologias ágeis. Liderança e Gestão de Pessoas Liderar, desenvolver e apoiar as lideranças das células do Hub, fortalecendo uma cultura de confiança, autonomia, accountability, colaboração e aprendizagem contínua; Promover um ambiente de trabalho ético, inclusivo e seguro, alinhado aos valores e compromissos comportamentais de MSF; Desenvolver capacidades de liderança, impulsionar a adoção de metodologias ágeis e estimular uma cultura de feedback e melhoria contínua. Estratégia de Engajamento, Marca e Mobilização de Recursos Liderar a definição e implementação da estratégia integrada de engajamento institucional de MSF-Brasil, garantindo alinhamento entre comunicação, marca, mobilização de recursos e relacionamento com públicos estratégicos; Fortalecer o posicionamento institucional e a reputação de MSF, incluindo a gestão de crises reputacionais e a consistência da comunicação multicanal; Impulsionar estratégias inovadoras para ampliar o engajamento da sociedade, fortalecer a base de apoiadores e promover o crescimento sustentável da receita; Representar a organização junto à mídia, parceiros institucionais, setor humanitário e demais públicos estratégicos. Gestão de Performance, Dados e Tecnologia Garantir que as estratégias e decisões do Hub sejam orientadas por dados, evidências e indicadores de desempenho; Definir e acompanhar indicadores estratégicos, promovendo uma cultura de inovação, aprendizagem contínua e melhoria de resultados; Assegurar a evolução e o uso estratégico de CRM, plataformas de dados, ferramentas digitais e capacidades analíticas voltadas ao engajamento e relacionamento com apoiadores; Liderar a priorização de iniciativas, investimentos e recursos, incluindo a gestão orçamentária do Hub. Representação Institucional e Articulação Global Atuar como principal ponto de articulação do Hub com lideranças regionais e internacionais de MSF, promovendo trocas de conhecimento, alinhamento estratégico e compartilhamento de melhores práticas; Contribuir para fóruns e discussões estratégicas internacionais relacionados a engajamento, comunicação, mobilização de recursos, marca, dados e inovação. Compromissos de Gestão de MSF-Brasil Atuar de forma alinhada aos valores, princípios e compromissos comportamentais da organização, promovendo gestão ética, inclusiva e colaborativa; Contribuir para o planejamento estratégico e o fortalecimento da atuação transversal entre áreas; Promover ativamente práticas de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI), contribuindo para um ambiente seguro e respeitoso para todas as pessoas. Requisitos: 4. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER? Graduação em Marketing, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas; Experiência em posições de liderança estratégica, com gestão de equipes e condução de projetos e iniciativas organizacionais de alta complexidade; Vivência na definição e implementação de estratégias de comunicação, marketing, marca, engajamento de públicos, relacionamento e/ou mobilização de recursos; Experiência em transformação organizacional, gestão de mudança e fortalecimento de culturas orientadas por dados; Conhecimento e atuação com CRM, plataformas de relacionamento, automação, gestão de dados e acompanhamento de indicadores de desempenho; Experiência em planejamento estratégico, gestão orçamentária e tomada de decisão baseada em dados; Experiência em gestão de reputação institucional e comunicação de crise; Conhecimento em estratégias de marketing, gestão de projetos, metodologias ágeis e negociação; Compreensão de segmentação de públicos, jornadas de engajamento e métricas de aquisição, retenção e conversão; Inglês fluente; Conhecimento do Microsoft 365; Interesse por temas humanitários e pelas realidades que afetam comunidades em situação de vulnerabilidade. 5. O QUE AUMENTA SUAS CHANCES? Pós-graduação ou MBA em Marketing, Estratégia, Inovação ou Gestão de Projetos; Experiência na gestão de equipes multidisciplinares; Experiência com MSF e/ou vivência em organizações internacionais, organizações da sociedade civil e/ou contextos de alta complexidade institucional; Experiência em prospecção e desenvolvimento de parcerias institucionais; Proficiência em Espanhol. 6. QUAIS SÃO AS COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS? Você precisará ter visão estratégica e pensamento analítico para compreender cenários complexos, conectar diferentes perspectivas e utilizar dados e evidências na definição de estratégias e na tomada de decisões. Será importante demonstrar planejamento e organização para estabelecer prioridades, coordenar diferentes frentes de atuação e garantir o alinhamento das equipes aos objetivos da organização. Além disso, será necessário liderança para mobilizar pessoas em torno de uma visão compartilhada, promover colaboração e engajamento, e iniciativa e inovação para identificar oportunidades, liderar mudanças e desenvolver novas soluções. Por fim, gerenciamento de estresse será essencial para manter equilíbrio, clareza e capacidade de decisão diante de cenários de pressão, mudanças e múltiplas demandas. PRINCÍPIOS E CULTURA DE SALVAGUARDA: MSF está em busca de pessoas que compartilhem do compromisso com uma cultura de salvaguarda, que visa garantir um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Buscamos promover e garantir a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações e práticas. Assim, fortalecemos nossa missão e asseguramos que todas as pessoas tenham a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer na organização. Candidaturas que demonstrem alinhamento com esses valores serão altamente valorizadas. Alinhada com os valores que orientam as ações da nossa organização em todo o mundo, priorizaremos a candidatura de pessoas que cumpram os requisitos estabelecidos e se identifiquem com um ou mais grupos minorizados, sendo eles: Pessoas Negras (Pretas e Pardas), Indígenas, Trans e PcD. PRAZO PARA INSCRIÇÃO: 13/09/2026 RETORNO: Ficamos muito felizes com o seu interesse em trabalhar em MSF! Gostaríamos de reforçar que, ao final do processo, todas as pessoas candidatas receberão um retorno. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Control Room Operator
description: The Control Room Operator is responsible for monitoring and controlling production processes and systems to ensure safe and efficient operations. The role operates the DCS, Fire & Gas, and ESD systems, monitors plant performance, and responds to operational deviations and emergencies. The position also supports well testing, troubleshooting activities, and accurate recording of operational data. Responsibilities: Operate the DCS, Fire & Gas System, ESD System. (Emergency Shutdown). To act consciously and safely in times of emergency by understanding your role and following the OIM´s instructions. Monitor the correct operation of all plant and equipment. Log taking and understanding and interpretation of data. Work closely with DCS Technician on all matters concerning the DCS or PLCs. (Program to control the plant). Use the DCS efficiently and react immediately in case of emergency. Maintain historical trends of the various process systems. To fill out the shift logbook with all relevant information regarding fire and gas systems, process conditions, and inhibition, and to ensure it is properly recorded and archived. Perform well testing and ensure the correct data is obtained through a report to be presented Well Testing Department. Test the wells and ensure correct data collection through a report to be presented to the Well Testing Department. Participate on plant troubleshooting. Inform Production Supervisor when the system is unstable or malfunctioning. Other duties that are correlated to the function as directed and requested by Production Supervisor Or Production Superintendent. Keep up certification applied to the function and medical certificates up to date. Attend Company training as defined. Perform all emergency duties assigned to their function, in response to the emergency, if applicable. Ensure compliance with BW procedures, applied to the function, including BW Permit to Work System. Need to be fully familiar and comply with Company Policies, Quality, HSE and all Procedures assigned to his title/position. Anticipate and notice any unsafe condition and assure that the correction actions are taken according to procedure. Responsible for your own safety and for the safety of your co-workers. Education Technical education required; Engineering degree is a plus Advanced English Level Experience Experience as a Control Room Operator or in a similar role. Knowledge Knowledge of Fire & Gas (F&G) detection logic and Emergency Shutdown (ESD) system architecture, including shutdown levels and Cause & Effect matrix, sufficient to recognize abnormal conditions and respondperthecompany's instructions. Knowledge of process safety systems and safe operating envelopes of the topside process, sufficient to support troubleshooting and inform the Production Supervisor of instability or malfunction. Knowledge of shift handover and logbook recording requirements for fire and gas systems, process conditions, and inhibition status. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Utility Operator
description: The Utility Operator operates and maintains engine room and utility systems to ensure operational continuity and energy efficiency. title: CHEFE DE CONFEITARIA
description: Se você é apaixonado(a) por confeitaria, gosta de trabalhar com excelência e busca crescer em um ambiente profissional, colaborativo e de alto padrão, essa oportunidade é para você! No Hilton, cada detalhe importa — e suas criações farão parte da experiência dos nossos hóspedes. O que você fará? Entre suas responsabilidades: Produzir sobremesas e itens de confeitaria conforme receitas, fichas técnicas e padrões Hilton; Organizar, coordenar e executar atividades do setor; Criar e desenvolver novas produções culinárias; Assegurar a qualidade e a apresentação impecável dos produtos servidos; Manter a organização, higiene e segurança alimentar em todas as etapas; Controlar insumos, evitar desperdícios e apoiar o fluxo de produção; Protocolar, organizar e distribuir ordens de serviço; Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe de cozinha e demais áreas para garantir um serviço eficiente. Diferenciais que te destacam: Criatividade no desenvolvimento de novos produtos; Vivência na hotelaria ou cozinhas de alto padrão; Perfil colaborativo, proativo e comprometido. Oportunidades reais de crescimento: Programas de desenvolvimento, treinamentos e plano de carreira. Benefícios competitivos: Salário compatível, alimentação, assistência médica/odontológica, uniforme, e descontos exclusivos em hospedagens pela rede Hilton. Reconhecimento: A Hilton está entre as melhores empresas para trabalhar no mundo. title: COORDENADOR DE PÓS-VENDAS | SERVIÇOS E PEÇAS – LINHA PESADA
description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. title: Storekeeper
description: The Materials Coordinator oversees onboard inventory, warehouse, and materials logistics activities, including requisitions, material code creation, and disembarkation logistics. The role works closely with onshore Procurement to coordinate materials planning and ensure operational requirements are met. The position requires strong organizational and coordination skills, technical accuracy, and proactive communication to optimize supply chain processes, ensure seamless materials flow, and drive continuous improvement across operations. Responsabilities: Maintain precise computer records using the FPSO's stock control software Ensure that stores are kept secure and operate control systems to prevent loss or theft Undertake regular and systematic inventory checks to verify the accuracy of the stock control system Receive stores onboard and accurately check them off against manifests and purchase orders, update the computer records accordingly and prepare and distribute the Materials Received Onboard summary Revert to Maintenance Superintendent any deficiency in the Material received Onboard Issue materials under the direction of the Maintenance Superintendent, record the issue and update the computer record accordingly Inform the Maintenance Superintendent when stock levels fall beneath the set minimum and prepare requisitions and update the computer records according to approved requisitions under the direction of the Maintenance Superintendent Systematically update minimum and maximum stock levels under the direction of the Maintenance Superintendent Keep an updated punch list of Computerized Maintenance System issues. Report it regularly to the Maintenance Superintendent Participate in internal stock audits and take corrective actions where identified Maintain a close working relationship with the BW dedicated buyer over material procurement and logistics Responsible for ensuring requisitions contain the maximum amount of information to enable the onshore based buyers to quickly identify and procure materials and services and to reduce technical clarifications and delays to the minimum Packing and identification of material to disembark as per instructions of MSupt, based on FPSO needs. Provide information to Logistic, in order to support the importation/exportation and local shipment of material Request and creation of Codes for stock control system, ensuring a cleaning and correct database of the materials used onboard. Analyzes and creation of Lists of Material to create B.O Attend the needs from GEMARE (E&C Warehouse Management and Asset Reporting) in order to do keep material management in accordance with the criteria of the Corporate Creation of Non-Conformance Report, based on visual inspection with support from technical department which requested the material. Attend the needs from Corporate Asset, to optimize and planning the stock as per their evaluation and recommendation. Register of PPE´s issued to be following Quality and HSE Procedures and standards Other duties that are correlated to the function as directed and requested by Maintenance Keep up certification applied to the function and medical certificates up to date Attend Company training as defined. Perform all emergency duties assigned to their function, in response to the emergency, if applicable Ensure compliance with BW procedures, applied to the function, including BW Permit to Work System Need to be fully familiar and comply with Company Policies, Quality, HSE and all Procedures assigned to his title/position Anticipate and notice any unsafe condition and assure that the correction actions are taken according to procedure Responsible for your own safety and for the safety of your co-workers Requirements Education High school completed Preferably Technical education Additional training in Logistics, Supply Chain, or related areas is considered a plus Experience Experience in storekeeping, preferably on FPSO Knowledge Advanced English #J-18808-Ljbffr

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Our AppSec team is at the forefront of enabling secure innovation at Nubank. About The Role As a Security Engineer in our Application Security (AppSec) team, you will be part of the group responsible for enabling secure software development practices across Nubank’s entire engineering organization. We support teams working with a diverse technology stack – including Clojure, Python, Go for backend and Kotlin, Swift, Dart for mobile – by embedding security into their SDLC. This role is ideal for someone with a strong foundation in application security concepts, who enjoys working closely with engineering teams to drive security best practices, and who has a keen interest in emerging areas such as AI security and threat modeling. Your mission will include helping design and deploy security tools in our CI/CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, SCA), performing threat modeling for new projects, supporting security reviews, and contributing to the automation of AppSec processes, including those involving new AI technologies like Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers and agents. You'll be responsible for Embed security practices into the SDLC across backend, mobile, and web applications. Deploy and maintain security tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, MAST) in CI/CD pipelines. Perform threat modeling and security reviews for new and existing projects. Develop scripts and tools (Python, Go, Bash) to automate security checks and processes. Collaborate with engineering teams to explain and remediate vulnerabilities. Support AI-related security initiatives, ensuring safe adoption of ML/AI features in products. Contribute to the evolution of internal security guidelines and baselines. Participate in cross-functional discussions to align security requirements with business goals. We Are Looking For a Person Who Has Must-have Solid understanding of application security concepts and secure software development practices. Hands‑on experience with CI/CD pipelines and implementing security tools (e.g., SAST, DAST, SCA). Knowledge of scripting/programming with commonly used languages like Python, Go, bash, etc for automation and tooling. Familiarity with container security tools (e.g., Trivy, Aqua). Experience working with modern software architectures: Web, Mobile, APIs, and MCPs. Strong communication and collaboration skills to work with multi‑disciplinary teams. Nice to Have Previous experience conducting security assessments in distributed systems environments. Experience with tools like Semgrep, Fortify, Checkmarx, Veracode. Experience with pipeline tools like Github Actions, Gitlab Workflow, others. Experience with AI security concepts and emerging AI/ML security risks. Familiarity with threat modeling methodologies (e.g., STRIDE, PASTA, OWASP Threat Dragon). Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements relevant to financial services. title: Lead Fraud Data Scientist
description: About Us At Félix, we're building the financial ecosystem for Latin immigrants in the U.S., starting with a revolution in remittances. Our core product is an AI-powered chatbot built on WhatsApp, allowing our users to send money home as easily as sending a text message. We leverage cutting-edge technology like AI, blockchain, and stablecoins to make cross-border payments faster, more affordable, and more accessible than ever before. We are a hyper-growth Series B company, backed by over $100 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, and General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an “Endeavour Entrepreneur” and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award. We are a group of extremely talented and dedicated high-performers, united by our shared obsession with a single goal: empowering our customers. We are all owners of Félix, driven by a bias for action and a true experimentation spirit to get shit done with urgency and focus. Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today. About the role As a Lead Data Scientist for our Fraud team, you will be on the front lines of protecting our company and our customers. You will leverage your expertise in machine learning, statistics, and data analysis to design, build, and deploy sophisticated models that detect and prevent fraudulent activity in real-time. This is a high-impact role where you will see your work directly translate into protecting millions of dollars and ensuring a trustworthy platform for our users. Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Strategy: Define the long-term machine learning strategy for the fraud team, establish technical best practices, and mentor junior data scientists. End-to-End Model Development: Own the entire lifecycle of fraud detection models, from data exploration and feature engineering to model training, validation, deployment, and monitoring. Credit & Lending Fraud Mitigation: Design and develop models specifically targeted at lending fraud typologies, including synthetic identity fraud, first-party loan default fraud, and application fraud. Advanced Analysis: Conduct deep-dive investigations into emerging fraud patterns and user behavior, using clustering, outlier detection, network analysis, and other unsupervised techniques to uncover hidden risks and organized fraud rings. Experimentation: Design and execute A/B tests to measure the impact of new models, rules, and strategies on both fraud detection rates and user experience. Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Risk, and Operations teams to translate business needs into data science solutions, seamlessly integrate ML scores with rule engines, and communicate complex results to non-technical audiences. Productionalize Models: Deploy, monitor, and maintain machine learning models in a cloud environment, ensuring high availability and performance. Reporting & Visualization: Build and maintain dashboards using tools like Tableau or Looker to track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as fraud loss rates, false positive rates, and model performance. Requirements Must-Haves Experience: 5+ years of experience in a hands-on data science role, building and deploying machine learning models. Leadership: Proven experience leading complex data science projects from inception to production, including setting technical direction and guiding peers. Python: Expert-level Python for data analysis and modeling (pandas, scikit-learn, etc.). SQL: Advanced SQL skills for complex data extraction and manipulation. Machine Learning Modeling: Deep experience with tree-based ML models (XGBoost, CatBoost, LightGBM) and statistical models (Logistic Regression, Lasso/Ridge). Model Explainability & Ethics: Deep understanding of model explainability frameworks (SHAP, LIME) and algorithmic fairness to ensure models comply with credit lending regulations. Sampling Techniques: Strong understanding of sampling techniques for handling highly imbalanced datasets. Unsupervised Learning: Practical experience with clustering and outlier detection techniques (e.g., K-Means, K Nearest Neighbors, Isolation Forest). Model Lifecycle & Cloud: Proven experience with the full modeling lifecycle, including model deployment, monitoring, and maintenance on a cloud platform like GCP, AWS, or Azure. Analytical Rigor: A solid foundation in statistics and experience designing and analyzing A/B tests. Communication: Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. Advanced English level. Nice to have Domain Experience: Direct experience in a FinTech, payments, or risk/fraud-focused role, particularly with exposure to credit or consumer lending. Alternative & Bureau Data: Experience working with traditional credit bureau data (Experian, Equifax, TransUnion) and alternative credit/identity data sources. Graph ML: Experience with Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) or graph analytics tools (e.g., Neo4j, NetworkX) to map complex fraud networks. Regulatory Familiarity: Familiarity with consumer lending regulations (e.g., FCRA, ECOA) and their impact on machine learning model development. MLOps: Hands-on MLOps experience (e.g., CI/CD for models, versioning, automated retraining). GCP / Vertex AI: Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), especially Vertex AI. Spanish and/or Portuguese speaker These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered. Nosso compromisso com a excelência e a inovação molda cada aspecto do nosso trabalho, e incentivamos constantemente o aprendizado contínuo e o desenvolvimento profissional. Responsabilidades Atender os clientes na empresa, externamente ou via telefone, identificando suas necessidades e orientando-os com todas as informações necessárias sobre os produtos disponíveis na empresa e sua adequada utilização; Apresentar e demonstrar os produtos, informando os valores e as possibilidades de compra para o cliente; Manter-se bem-informado quanto às condições de vendas da empresa e como se comparam com as condições da concorrência; Registrar na folha de trabalho e/ou agenda os dados do cliente, suas sugestões, reclamações e opiniões sobre o atendimento recebido e os produtos oferecidos; Dar acompanhamento na agenda (via sistema); Conferir documentações de veículos negociados na venda; Emitir folha de pedido de faturamento; Consultar cheques e/ou crédito de clientes junto ao setor correspondente, para atendimento de pedidos; Oferecer a todos os clientes test Drive e produtos agregados à venda do veículo (Financiamento, Acessórios, Emplacamentos, Seguros e outros); Observar as práticas da concorrência quanto a preços e ofertas. Ensino Médio completo; Experiência comprovada em vendas de veículos.; Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão de vendas; CNH categoria B e prática de direção. Informações Adicionais Remuneração competitiva; Benefícios adicionais, como vale transporte, vale alimentação, seguro de vida, plano de saúde, plano odontológico, gympass e previdência privada; Oportunidade de aprendizado e desenvolvimento profissional; Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo; Possibilidade de crescimento dentro da empresa. Todas as ações nas empresas do grupo Líder são conduzidas de maneira a refletir a preocupação em entender e atender as necessidades de nossos clientes, em clima de respeito mútuo e amizade, que garantam nossa sobrevivência e desenvolvimento. Além disso, nossas relações com os parceiros que representamos devem se pautar pelo alinhamento com suas respectivas filosofias empresariais, garantindo a desejada contrapartida de resultados, em clima de honesta e saudável parceria, que gere crescimento recíproco. Valorizamos o bom relacionamento, a disponibilidade e disposição para o trabalho, o espírito de integração e o sentimento de obrigação pessoal para levar a sério uma atribuição. É objetivo do grupo Líder assegurar aos colaboradores que exerçam este comportamento e a participação no sucesso do nosso negócio. INOVAÇÃO A atualização tecnológica é, para nós, objeto de atenção especial através de planos específicos de capacitação do pessoal, absorção de novas tecnologias e na modernização dos equipamentos. Nosso foco é pensar de forma inovadora, para garantir a qualidade dos serviços e do atendimento e assegurar uma produtividade compatível com grandes ideias e ações sustentáveis. A história de nosso grupo é, felizmente, uma história de sucesso empresarial. Até aqui, temos nos mostrado competentes no alcance e superação dos resultados, em todos os campos: Econômico-financeiro, de tecnologia, de imagem e, sobretudo, de patrimônio Humano. Desde 1957, a empresa teve um crescimento contínuo e equilibrado, fruto de uma administração segura e competente. Hoje, o Grupo Líder, consolidado como um dos maiores grupos corporativos do país, é um conglomerado de empresas modernas e adaptadas às mudanças da economia brasileira, com diversos investimentos nos setores de comércio, indústria e serviços. Nosso investimento em novos negócios, infra-estrutura operacional, capital humano e responsabilidade social, são condizentes com a confiança que possuímos em nosso país. E a seriedade com a qual atendemos os nossos serviços, definem bem a essência de nossa estratégia empresarial. Entendemos que o Negócio de qualquer empreendimento é satisfazer as necessidades de seus clientes e as expectativas de seus acionistas. Nossa busca é permanente para que tenhamos os melhores resultados para a sustentabilidade dos nossos negócios. Are you available to work in person at Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brasil? #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Programme Assistant
description: This job is with United Nations, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly. Result of Service The consultant shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference, and will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams. Work Location Rio de Janeiro (RJ), Brazil Expected duration One (1) month Duties and Responsibilities Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners, for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the **** Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. In ****, the Municipal Government of Rio de Janeiro had the Periferia Viva Maré Project selected under the Periferia Viva Program – Favela Urbanization, coordinated by the Ministry of Cities and implemented locally. Its objective is to articulate public policies and strengthen community-based initiatives in peripheral territories, promoting improvements in living conditions, particularly in the program's priority areas: urban infrastructure, social facilities, social and community strengthening, innovation, technology, and the expansion of opportunities. UN-Habitat and the Municipality of Rio de Janeiro have maintained a longstanding partnership, and the agency was selected to serve as the Technical Assistance partner for the implementation of the project. To properly implement the above-mentioned project, a Programme Assistant is required. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Programme Assistant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Programme Assistant will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: Provide administrative and logistical support for the planning, execution, and follow-up of project activities, including meetings, missions, and events. Assist in the preparation, organization, and consolidation of technical reports, presentations, and documentation for internal use and for external partners. Support the coordination and communication among stakeholders, including counterparts involved. Maintain updated records and filing systems related to project activities, ensuring timely documentation of results achieved. Perform other related duties as required to ensure effective implementation and monitoring of the project. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities' report. Qualifications/special skills Education Required: Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Geography, Sociology, Law, Economics, Social Work, Social Sciences, or related fields is required, or additional three (3) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience Minimum three (3) years of experience in the above-mentioned fields of work, particu-lly in research in favelas, community mobilization and teamwork in Brazil, is required. Experience in the social area and in supporting fieldwork, preferably in the public sec-tor and in vulnerable areas, is desirable. Previous experience working in the United Nations is desirable. Skills Good computer skills in Windows and Office packages and Web search engines are required. Good handling of online event and conference tools is desirable. Competencies Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good ur-ban governance and local and regional development. Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsi-bility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines. Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret mes-sages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capac-ity to write documents for diverse audiences. Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic envi-ronment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guar-antee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization. The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementa-tion of the activities related to the project development. The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating. The person will prepare databases related to the project running. The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff. The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency. The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content. Languages English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office. For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of Eng-lish is desirable. Additional Information Travel details: Not Applicable. Remuneration LICA 1 UNOPS Salary Scale. Notes Appointment against this post is on local basis and only nationals from Brazil or external candidates who hold a permanent visa in Brazil may apply. The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. It is required for all the curricular information to be inserted in the system, which may take a few hours. Only complete applications in English will be considered. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. Due to the volume of applications received, receipt of applications cannot be acknowledged individually. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. #J-18808-Ljbffr
